en.headline: 405 own commits, 713 automated, 36 issue actions across 12 repos
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the sogeisetsu daily-report pipeline, a new OpenCode agent sandbox and skill-management plugin, plus a browser translation extension.
en.overview:
The window was dominated by work on the personal **sogeisetsu** repository, where the daily-report pipeline was reworked: the AI layer's duplicate empty gate was removed, blank days no longer swallow discussion sections, commit attribution now supports aliases for non-GitHub account emails, and a new 30-day GitHub activity AI summary was added with a home-page card and a standalone page. The CLI gained a `--force` flag that skips the comment-count snapshot freeze and re-fetches snapshots for finalized days, and candidate entries are no longer filtered by whether `updated_at` falls inside the window.

A second large thread was OpenCode tooling. `opencode-agent-sandbox` was started and filled with an AGENTS.md plus a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, later generalized beyond Git and GitHub. `opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings to LF, and shipped four releases from 0.1.0-rc.0 through 1.2.0, including a switch to JSON tool results with a declared output schema.

`opencode-go-model-picker` reached 1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1. The releases added shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery with skipped built-ins reported, priced accounting with quota math, and a large documentation simplification that cut the model-facing text by roughly an order of magnitude. Script fixes covered atomic snapshot writes, version-badge drift and calibration dates.

Elsewhere, `sopen-translate` was initialized as an MV3 extension with page translation, bilingual rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer and glossary pipeline, then refactored to drop selection translation. `pixel-logo-toolkit` shipped 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI and an English-first README. `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes, a single-button theme switcher and visual refinements; `asset-inventory` released 1.15.4 and 1.15.5 correcting skill invocation facts; `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples.

Upstream, issue activity concentrated on **openchamber/openchamber** and **anomalyco/opencode**, with bug reports on MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context-panel breakdowns and MiMo image handling, plus one PowerToys Shortcut Guide report. No pull requests or reviews were recorded, and no days in the window are missing data.

highlights.text: Commented on the AI narrative generation failure tracking issue.
Opened and closed a temporary opencode /oc smoke test issue.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects images.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on Hold-Win activation.
First stable release of the skill_management plugin, freezing the 1.x surface.
Simplified the skill to one entry point and one reference, cutting model-facing text by about 92%.
Added automatic text wrapping, overflow protection and a full CLI manual.

zh.headline: 本人提交 405 次、自动提交 713 次，12 个仓库共 36 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 本周期主要投入日报流水线、OpenCode 智能体沙箱与技能管理插件，以及一个浏览器翻译扩展。
zh.overview:
本周期的工作重心在个人仓库 **sogeisetsu**，日报流水线做了较大改造：移除 AI 层重复的空内容闸门，空白天不再吞掉 discussion 等附加段，提交归属支持非 GitHub 账号邮箱的别名，并新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结（首页卡片加独立页）。CLI 增加 `--force`，可跳过评论数快照冻结并重取定稿日快照，候选条目也不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤。

第二条主线是 OpenCode 工具链。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 从零建立，写入 AGENTS.md 与知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑，后来把知识范围从 Git/GitHub 泛化。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，计划文件迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，换行统一为 LF，并从 0.1.0-rc.0 一路发布到 1.2.0，其中 1.1.0 改为返回 JSON 工具结果并声明输出 schema。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1。这些版本加入共享的 JSON 与代理辅助模块、更完整的智能体发现（跳过项单独报告）、带定价的额度核算，以及一次大幅文档精简，把模型需要阅读的文本压缩了约一个数量级。脚本修复涉及快照原子写入、版本徽章漂移与校准日期。

其他仓库方面，`sopen-translate` 初始化为 MV3 扩展，具备整页翻译、双语渲染、分块、熔断、提供商协议层与术语表流水线，随后重构去掉划词翻译。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 0.2.0 与 0.3.0，加入自动折行、溢出保护、双语 CLI 与英文优先的 README。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复移动端视口、改为单按钮主题切换并做视觉精修；`asset-inventory` 发布 1.15.4 与 1.15.5 修正技能调用说明；`myBlog` 补充 OpenChamber 截图样例。

上游仓库的 issue 互动集中在 **openchamber/openchamber** 与 **anomalyco/opencode**，涉及 MCP 设置遗漏 Console 服务、会话保留提示过期、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比以及 MiMo 图片处理等问题，另有一条 PowerToys 快捷键指南报告。本周期没有 PR 与评审记录，窗口内没有缺失数据的日期。

highlights.text: 在 AI 叙述生成失败的跟踪 issue 下留言。
新开并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
提交快捷键指南在 Hold-Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException 的报告。
skill_management 插件首个稳定版，冻结 1.x 的接口范围。
精简为单一入口与单一参考文档，模型需阅读的文本减少约 92%。
加入文本自动折行、溢出保护与完整的命令行手册。
